goal: Allow consensus block and header validation functions to be called and tested in isolation
Avoid requiring full chainstate setup and internal clock reads to check validity
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by testing direct invocation of isolated validation routines (janb84)
Supports taking explicit parameters and time to simplify error testing (josibake, optout21)
Contested suggestion to use helper functions to collapse test boilerplate (sedited)
Unanswered suggestion to strengthen test claims (optout21)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it enables direct unit testing of consensus validation rules in isolation
Allows testing validation error cases with simple inputs without chainstate setup
Unblocks factoring out a stateless validation library but remains deferrable refactoring
